controlledFaultScope: Only localhost Worker HTTP response substitution with inert or scheduled-late-error scripts; not a natural solver timeout or formal research result.
scope: 51 unique first Chromium cases cover V14 saved natural-D0 evidence, all 14 comparisons/adverse identifiers, mobile and historical workbench/execution/resource teaching interactions. Two independent new desktop/mobile cases click V14 PDF, editable PPT and Chinese/Korean reports, eight actual downloads matched to material original bytes. No rerun of the 51 cases; native methods and entrant readiness are separate.
downloadBinaryRetention: Exact selected screenshots, events, harness, static inventory, case records and download receipts are archived. Downloaded blobs (including duplicate JSON, ZIP, PDF, PPT and reports) are excluded; current original materials and final source packages are retained separately. No portable lossless claim is made for the intermediate candidate ZIP blob.
finalCandidateHandling: The bound inventory identifies the actual tested candidate. Later changes are evidence/status/recovery records and transport packages; root separately checks identical runtime HTML/JS/CSS and final deployed file bytes.
